description: Bihar row of the portal's all-states summary, one row per financial year and Panchayat tier
definition_evidence: Portal report "State & Year Wise Summary Report Financial Year:-<FY>" (FileRedirect.jsp?FD=priasoftOverview&name=statewiseClosureReport<FY>.html)
limitation: One snapshot per year; the 2012-13 to 2024-25 files were generated on 23 Oct 2024 (2024-25 is a mid-year snapshot); Bihar values are 0 before 2020-21 because accounts were not kept in eGramSwaraj

description: Receipts and payments of each Panchayat tier, aggregated by district, with the portal's Total row
definition_evidence: Portal report "District wise Receipt and Payment Statement Financial Year:-<FY> State:-Bihar" (FD=ExpenditureReport<FY>/10&name=10.html)
limitation: Column definitions and units change in 2021-22 (Receipts, Payments → OB + Receipts (Cr), Payments (Cr)); one snapshot per FY with its own generation date

description: Receipts and payments of the Block Panchayat and Gram Panchayat tiers, aggregated by block, with a Total row per district
definition_evidence: Portal report "Block wise Receipt and Payment Statement" (FD=ExpenditureReport<FY>/10/<district>&name=<district>.html)
limitation: Preliminary table has block names but no block codes; codes are recovered from the page's own links in the validated layer

description: Receipts and payments of every Gram Panchayat in a block, with the portal's Total row per block
definition_evidence: Portal report "Village wise Receipt and Payment Statement" (FD=ExpenditureReport<FY>/10/<district>&name=<block>.html)
limitation: Collected only for 2020-21 and 2024-25; the page does not print a unit or say whether Receipts include the opening balance

description: Voucher counts, receipts and payments for one scheme, by district and tier, or Bihar's row on the all-states scheme page
definition_evidence: Portal reports "District wise Receipt and Payment Statement … Scheme:-<scheme>" (FD=SchemeWiseExpenditureReport<FY>/<scheme>//10&name=10.html) and "State wise Receipt and Payment Statement … Scheme:-<scheme>"
limitation: Bihar pages exist only for OWN and XV FC (state rows also for FFC 2021-23); a scheme absent from the all-states page means not listed, not zero

description: Month-wise cash flow of one Panchayat body: the Zilla Parishad (district page) or a Block Panchayat (block page)
definition_evidence: Portal report "Month Wise Payment and Receipt Statement" (FD=ExpFY<FY>/10&name=<district or block code>.html)
limitation: Block pages collected only for 2020-21 and 2024-25; meaning of the cancellation columns is not stated on the page

description: Number of vouchers entered per month, by voucher type, for a district or a block
definition_evidence: Portal report "Month wise Summary Report" (FD=FinancialYear<FY>/10&name=<district or block code>.html)
limitation: Block pages collected for 2020-21, 2024-25 and 2026-27 (2026-27 in progress)
